# Data Source: tfe_organization_audit_configuration

Gets information about the audit configuration for a given organization.

~> **Note:** This data source requires using the provider with HCP Terraform.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        new DataTfeOrganizationAuditConfiguration.DataTfeOrganizationAuditConfiguration(this, "example", new DataTfeOrganizationAuditConfigurationConfig {
            Organization = "my-org-name"
        });
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `Organization` (String) Name of the organization.

### Optional

- `AuditTrailsEnabled` (Boolean) Whether Audit Trails is enabled for the organization.
- `HcpLogStreamingEnabled` (Boolean) Whether HCP Audit Log Streaming is enabled for the organization.
- `HcpOrganization` (String) The destination HCP Organization for HCP Audit Log Streaming.

### Read-Only

- `Id` (String) The ID of the organization audit configuration.
